name: net_hb1_bailey
description: VUH-2343 guarded development: two local player-default instances qualify the existing BC private-clone/client-emission path, then require exact Bailey missing-party construction, distinct private/local native bindings, native Leon retention, HP parity and HB08_MS102 mission completion before a GoA egress. Host warps are development setup. No enemy kills, mission-result or save-folder writes. The 04/0A control proves clone arrival only, not first-visit Shadow grounding; this is not D15 real-door acceptance.

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for i in range(2))
[actors(i) for i in range(2)]
[runtime_log(i).count('Desync notice') for i in range(2)]
[log_count('[privatestatus] kind=3 ',i) for i in range(2)]
all(log_count('[privatestatus] kind=3 ',i)>saved['private_bind_baseline'][i] and peek('0x9ACDF8','u32',i)==0x12020000 for i in range(2))

[log_matches(r'\[privatestatus\] kind=3 serial=(?P<serial>\d+) tid=\d+ actor=(?P<clone>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) local=(?P<local>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) status=(?P<status>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) localStatus=(?P<localStatus>[0-9A-Fa-f]+)',i)[-1] for i in range(2)]
all(int(b['clone'],16)!=int(b['local'],16) and int(b['status'],16)!=int(b['localStatus'],16) and int(b['status'],16)>0 and int(b['localStatus'],16)>0 for b in saved['emission_clone_bindings'])
steps.message: The armed 566 clone must bind a distinct private status and canonical local actor before emission

steps.expr: 20 < saved['courtyard_start'][2]-saved['courtyard_probe'][2] < 300 and abs(saved['courtyard_probe'][0]-saved['courtyard_start'][0]) < 150 and saved['courtyard_probe'][2]>1550
steps.message: Courtyard camera-forward input must move safely toward the measured spawn region

steps.expr: len(log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] client emitted epoch='+str(saved['emission_clone_arrival']['epoch'])+r' key=808476514 header=30 record=\d+ ',1))==5 and len(enemy_hps(0))==len(enemy_hps(1))==5 and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1)

{'epoch':saved['emission_clone_arrival']['epoch'],'host':log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] sent epoch='+str(saved['emission_clone_arrival']['epoch'])+r' seq=(?P<seq>\d+) key=808476514 header=30 record=(?P<record>\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\d+)',0),'client':log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] client emitted epoch='+str(saved['emission_clone_arrival']['epoch'])+r' key=808476514 header=30 record=(?P<record>\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\d+)',1),'blocked':log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] client blocked epoch='+str(saved['emission_clone_arrival']['epoch'])+r' key=808476514 header=30 record=(?P<record>\d+)',1),'actors':[actors(i) for i in range(2)]}

len(saved['qualified_client_emission']['host'])==5 and sorted((b['record'],b['netId'],b['seq']) for b in saved['qualified_client_emission']['host'])==sorted((b['record'],b['netId'],b['seq']) for b in saved['qualified_client_emission']['client']) and len(set(b['record'] for b in saved['qualified_client_emission']['client']))==5 and all(a['objectId']==302 for i in range(2) for a in enemies(i))
steps.message: Five current-epoch qualified host emissions must be consumed once each by the client with matching native Shadows

steps.expr: all(log_count('[privatestatus] initialization refused',i)==0 and log_count('[privatestatus] stats requested=1 ready=1 installed=255 faults=0',i)>0 and len(log_matches(r'\[privatestatus\] stats requested=1 ready=0',i))==0 and peek('0x9ACDF8','u32',i)==0x12020000 for i in range(2))
steps.message: Private-status safety and the automatic clone row must remain armed through qualified client emission

steps.expr: [actors(i) for i in range(2)]
all(location(i)==[4,8,0,52,52,0] and any(a['name']=='P_EX100' for a in actors(i)) for i in range(2))

[{'location':location(i),'actors':actors(i),'bridge':bridge(i),'partyRow':peek('0x9ACDF4','u32',i),'members':[peek('0x2A25300','u16',i),peek('0x2A25302','u16',i),peek('0x2A25304','u16',i)]} for i in range(2)]
all(log_count('[missing-party] born bound=1',i)==1 for i in range(2))

all(log_count('[missing-party] born bound=0',i)==0 and log_count('[privatestatus] stats requested=1 ready=0',i)==0 and sum(a['objectId']==84 for a in actors(i))==2 and any(a['objectId']==1564 for a in actors(i)) for i in range(2))
steps.message: Both peers must retain exactly two native Soras, healthy private status and native Leon

steps.expr: all(mission(i) and mission(i)['file']=='HB08_MS102.bar' for i in range(2))
[mission(0),mission(1)]
[log_matches(r'\[missing-party\] entry=(?P<entry>Constructor|Allocate) caller=(?P<caller>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) key=(?P<key>-?\d+) form=(?P<form>-?\d+)',i) for i in range(2)]

all(any(e['entry']=='Constructor' and e['key']=='1' and e['form']=='0' for e in rows) and any(e['entry']=='Allocate' and e['caller']=='3A7B1B' and e['key']=='1' and e['form']=='0' for e in rows) for rows in saved['bailey_f1_entries'])
steps.message: F1 must capture native Constructor and exact normal-Sora Allocate entries under each missing scope

steps.expr: len(enemy_hps(0))>0
[[(a['name'],a['objectId'],a['hp'],a['maxHp'],a['position']) for a in enemies(i)] for i in range(2)]

steps.until: len(log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[spawn-birth\] ticket .*objectId=317)',1))>0 and any(a['objectId']==317 and a['hp']>0 for a in enemies(1))

steps.expr: len(log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[spawn-birth\] ticket .*objectId=317)',1))>0 and any(a['objectId']==317 and a['hp']>0 for a in enemies(1))
steps.message: Pause must occur with a living friend Creeper, after native emission

steps.expr: [{'mission':mission(i),'menu':peek('0x7435D0','u8',i),'frozen':peek('0x2A171E8','i32',i),'pauseBlockers':peek('0xABB878','u32',i),'births':log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[spawn-birth\] ticket .*objectId=317)',i),'retired':log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[bailey317\] retired[^\r\n]*)',i)} for i in range(2)]
[{'menu':peek('0x7435D0','u8',i),'frozen':peek('0x2A171E8','i32',i),'pauseBlockers':peek('0xABB878','u32',i),'mission':mission(i)} for i in range(2)]
all(peek('0x7435D0','u8',i) in (8,10) for i in range(2))
[{'menu':peek('0x7435D0','u8',i),'frozen':peek('0x2A171E8','i32',i),'mission':mission(i),'retired':log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[bailey317\] retired[^\r\n]*)',i)} for i in range(2)]
all(peek('0x7435D0','u8',i)==255 for i in range(2))
[{'mission':mission(i),'menu':peek('0x7435D0','u8',i),'retired':log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[bailey317\] retired[^\r\n]*)',i)} for i in range(2)]
[log_matches(r'(?P<line>\[bailey317\] retired[^\r\n]*)',i) for i in range(2)]
[{'location':location(i),'actors':actors(i),'bridge':bridge(i)} for i in range(2)]
[runtime_log(i).count('Desync notice')-saved['notices_before'][i] for i in range(2)]
enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1)
all(saved['bailey_fight'][str(i)]['presses']>0 and not saved['bailey_fight'][str(i)].get('error') for i in range(2))
steps.message: Both native Soras must make positive combat input; a bot loop or clip alone is insufficient

steps.expr: all(not enemy_hps(i) and mission(i) and mission(i)['file']=='HB08_MS102.bar' and (mission(i)['flags']&0x14)==0x14 and mission(i)['result']!=2 for i in range(2))
[mission(0),mission(1)]
[log_matches(r'\[spawn-birth\] ticket frame=(?P<frame>\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\d+) seq=(?P<sequence>\d+) actor=(?P<actor>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) objectId=317',i) for i in range(2)]
len(saved['bailey317_birth_tickets'][1])>=5 and log_count('[mission-mirror] host end trap=',0)>0 and log_count('[mission-mirror] client end like the host file=HB08_MS102.bar',1)==1
steps.message: Five Creeper birth tickets and exactly one replayed Bailey mission end are required

steps.expr: [[(a['objectId'],a['hp'],a['maxHp']) for a in enemies(i) if a['hp']>0] for i in range(2)]
saved['bailey_enemy_end']==[[],[]]
steps.message: Both native mission ends require empty, matching living enemy HP/counts

steps.expr: [log_matches(r'\[missing-party\] attachment allowed=(?P<allowed>\d+) roots=(?P<roots>\d+) clone=(?P<clone>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) controller=(?P<controller>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) expectedController=(?P<expectedController>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) record=(?P<record>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) expectedRecord=(?P<expectedRecord>[0-9A-Fa-f]+)',i) for i in range(2)]

all(len(rows)>=2 and all(r['allowed']=='1' and r['roots']=='1' and r['controller']==r['expectedController'] and r['record']==r['expectedRecord'] for r in rows) for rows in saved['bailey_attachments'])
steps.message: Both private clones must stay attached to the original Bailey controller and retained record throughout settled gameplay

steps.expr: len([s for s in (saved['bailey_fight_before_pause_samples']+saved['bailey_fight_samples']) if 'value' in s])>0 and all(not m or m['file']!='HB08_MS102.bar' or m['result']!=2 for s in (saved['bailey_fight_before_pause_samples']+saved['bailey_fight_samples']) if 'value' in s for m in s['value'])

steps.expr: all(not m or m['result']!=2 for m in saved['bailey_mission_end'])
steps.message: The Bailey mission must finish successfully on both games
